concerns.text: SC‑001 (≤ 10 % degradation) is only referenced in the mapping table (T018 → T019) but no concrete task verifies that the observed success‑rate degradation stays within the 10 % bound.
SC‑003 (wall‑clock skill‑selection latency) has no dedicated task; none of the listed tasks record or assert latency measurements for the retrieval/interpolation mechanisms.
SC‑004 (top‑k sensitivity analysis) is absent; there is no task that performs a sweep over different k values and validates robustness of retrieval performance.
